title: Descent of the special-chart elimination substitution
statement: For prepared Popescu data d, compatible c and cmod, and hc identifying the original variables, the unlocalized quotient D0=d.liftingAlgebra/(pi) admits a C0-algebra homomorphism to P=MvPolynomial (E k) (C0[1/a0]), sending each free auxiliary generator indexed by E k to its polynomial variable. Here C0=Cbar/(pi), D0 has its C0-algebra structure from cmod, and a0 is the class of epsilon(reduced(a k)). This statement constructs only the map out of the unlocalized quotient; it does not assert a retraction of the special-chart map or injectivity.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP, displayed calculation modulo pi and comparison of chart coefficients; read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Substitute the original variables by their coefficient classes, the free variables by polynomial variables, and complementary z_l by a_k inverse times sum h_klj Z_j. Modulo pi the relations f_l vanish, and the k-th chart relations vanish by substitution and normalization.

For every other chart compare the two expansions of a_k a_kprime f_l in the reduced localized conormal module. The specified basis forces each b_j=a_kprime h_klj-sum h_kprime,ljprime h_k,jprimej to vanish in the reduced coefficient chart. The surjective presentation with its specified kernel identifies that chart with Cbar[1/a_k], and passage to C0[1/a0] preserves zero. Substitution thus kills all defining relations.

Descend the substitution through the defining quotient, ULift and quotient by pi. Check C0-algebra compatibility using hc for original variables, constants for R, polynomial induction, hd.surjective and hcmod. The values on free variables follow from the substitution. No extension through localization or left-inverse assertion is made here.

lean.statement:
theorem popescu_special_chart_substitution (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (cmod : (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) →+*
      (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (hcmod : cmod.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) = c.toRingHom) (k : Fin d.r) :
    let C₀ := Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)
    let D₀ := d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)
    letI := cmod.toAlgebra
    let A := Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k))))
    ∃ g : D₀ →ₐ[C₀] MvPolynomial (d.E k) A,
      ∀ j : d.E k, g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        (ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk d.definingIdeal (MvPolynomial.X (.inr j.1))))) =
          MvPolynomial.X j
